title: Auto start-stop and start-related features
summary: Feedback about this topic centers on dislike of the auto start-stop function, with smaller pockets of appreciation for convenience features and many fragments that are too brief or mixed across unrelated start-related issues to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise convenience features such as automatic mirror unfolding and EV preconditioning behaving like remote start.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on strong dislike of auto start-stop behavior and frustration with the start-stop button placement near other controls.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews combine dissatisfaction with having to disable auto start-stop repeatedly or explicit dislike of the feature with limited balancing context in the sampled fragments.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include brief reports that the vehicle would not start, questions about bypassing or switching off auto start-stop, and other start-related comments without clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The topic mixes several related but distinct subjects, including auto start-stop preferences, remote start or preconditioning, control layout, and reports that the vehicle would not start.
Some examples are too short or truncated to determine whether they describe a complaint, a question, or a routine explanation.
